_doc: V4 additions (crypto). Exchange APIs (Binance, Bybit, OKX, Kraken, Coinbase, Deribit, Hyperliquid, CoinGecko, data.binance.vision) are all blocked by the environment's network policy (checked 2026-10-09); only GitHub/PyPI are reachable. All sources pinned to commits.

bitstamp_btcusd_1m.type: REAL EXCHANGE SPOT (Bitstamp BTC/USD trades aggregated to 1-minute OHLCV)
bitstamp_btcusd_1m.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 for rows <= 2025-01-07 (attribution: Zielak (mczielinski), Bitcoin Historical Data, Kaggle); repository terms for API-collected rows after
bitstamp_btcusd_1m.limitations: single venue; no bid/ask; minutes without trades carry the last price with zero volume; known community gaps in early years

dukascopy_mirror_crypto.type: UNKNOWN VENUE (USDT pairs look like Binance spot; BTCUSD/ETHUSD rows look like a CFD/aggregator feed)
dukascopy_mirror_crypto.limitations: provenance undocumented; survivorship: only coins still listed in 2023; treated as EXPLORATORY-grade data only

binance_funding_2020_2024.type: REAL EXCHANGE funding settlements (Binance/Bybit/others, BTC-USDT & ETH-USDT perps)
binance_funding_2020_2024.timezone: file stamps are UTC+3 (settlements at 03/11/19); converted to UTC 00/08/16 by the loader (asserted)

multi_venue_funding_2025_2026.type: REAL EXCHANGE funding settlements with mark price (Binance/Bybit 8h; Hyperliquid hourly)
multi_venue_funding_2025_2026.limitations: mark price only at settlement times; fee config in the repo is a placeholder
